session_initial_cmdsn.description: Initial Command Sequence Number for the session.

session_cmds_max.description: Maximum number of commands that may be in flight at once per session.

session_queue_depth.description: Maximum number of commands that may be queued per LUN.

connection_max_recv_dlength.description: Maximum data segment length (in bytes) that the initiator can receive in a single iSCSI PDU.

connection_first_burst_length.description: Maximum data segment length (in bytes) for the first data transfer in an unsolicited PDU sequence.

connection_max_burst_length.description: Maximum data segment length (in bytes) for subsequent data transfers in a sequence.

node_session_auth_authmethod.description: Authentication method used for the session (e.g., 'CHAP', 'None').

node_session_auth_username.description: CHAP username for the session (outgoing authentication).

node_session_auth_password.description: CHAP password for the session (outgoing authentication).

node_session_auth_username_in.description: CHAP username expected from target (incoming authentication).

node_session_auth_password_in.description: CHAP password expected from target (incoming authentication).

discovery_sendtargets_auth_username.description: CHAP username used during SendTargets discovery (outgoing).

discovery_sendtargets_auth_password.description: CHAP password used during SendTargets discovery (outgoing).

discovery_sendtargets_auth_username_in.description: CHAP username expected from target during discovery (incoming).

discovery_sendtargets_auth_password_in.description: CHAP password expected from target during discovery (incoming).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to bind sessions to. Leave empty for default behavior (auto-detect).

node_session_timeo_replacement_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before replacing a failed connection.

node_session_timeo_err_timeo.description: Time (in seconds) after which a connection error triggers recovery action.

node_session_timeo_abort_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before aborting a stuck command.

node_session_timeo_login_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for login completion.

node_session_timeo_logout_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for logout completion.

node_session_timeo_noop_out_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between NOP-Out commands to keep connection alive.

node_session_timeo_noop_out_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to wait for NOP-Out response before considering connection dead.

node_conn_scan.description: LUN scan mode: 'manual' (scan only LUNs configured) or 'automatic' (probe all LUNs).

node_session_err_timeo_action.description: Action to take on timeout: 'reset', 'abort', 'flush', or 'none'.

node_session_isns_server.description: Hostname or IP address of iSNS server (if iSNS is enabled).

node_startup.description: Session startup behavior: 'manual' (start on demand), 'automatic' (start at boot), or 'onboot' (start during kernel boot if supported).

discovery_sendtargets_auto_node_discover.description: Automatically create node records from discovery responses.
